debuffs.summary: The character is losing blood after a trap, blade, or sharp debris event.

combat_bridge.notes: Can later map to the existing combat bleeding status when character-level dungeon state exists.

debuffs.summary: The character is affected by venom, spores, or tainted dungeon residue.
The character is slowed by an injured leg or twisted ankle.

combat_bridge.notes: Target bridge is reduced starting MP, initially around -50% when character-level modifiers exist.

debuffs.summary: The party suffered blunt-force injury while forcing through an obstacle.

combat_bridge.notes: Deferred until dungeon debuffs can target specific combat units.

debuffs.summary: The party is worn down by difficult traversal and poor conditions.

combat_bridge.notes: Can later reduce initiative or starting AP/MP.

debuffs.summary: The party is rattled by stress, darkness, or a frightening dungeon event.

combat_bridge.notes: Deferred until morale/stress or accuracy modifiers are bridged.

debuffs.summary: The character is strained after lifting, climbing, or forcing debris.

combat_bridge.notes: May later reduce carrying efficiency or combat movement.

debuffs.summary: The character is burned by fire, oil, steam, or volatile dungeon hazards.

combat_bridge.notes: Deferred until fire/burn combat effects exist.
